review_reference: Owner decisions of 2026-11-17, verbatim in chat: Q90 "Q90 A since its the best option that gives each product seperate environment"; Q91 "Q91 A". Meaning: in the Q88 product gate (identity-api src/auth/product-gate.ts, PR #256), an administrator (organization.manage, or the administrator of a self-signed-up facility awaiting review) counts as a hospital role only at an organisation that is not recorded as a laboratory or a pharmacy; an organisation with no recorded kind, or with any hospital or clinic kind, is a hospital (Q91 A); laboratory only admits the administrator on lab., pharmacy only on pharmacy., laboratory and pharmacy on both, and in each case also on the site of each product the organisation holds (ehr., migrate., lab. or pharmacy.; never outreach.), so a laboratory or pharmacy that bought ehr or migrate keeps that site (a review fix of 17 November 2026 for the owner to confirm when signing). Clinical hospital roles (ehr.encounter.write) and the lab, pharmacy and outreach roles are unchanged. Production has 0001-0123 (0122 and 0123 signed as Q84 and released); its pending set after this branch is exactly 0124. Unsigned: reviewed_by stays empty until the owner signs under 0124.
evidence: Migration 0124_organization_staff_kinds.sql plus its runtime-grants.sql block. WHY: the kind is recorded only in identity.organization_applications (organization_type: clinic, hospital, laboratory, pharmacy, other; product_code), the products an organisation holds only in identity.organization_products; the Identity runtime has no privilege on either table, and identity.organization_self_service_state (0086) answers only self-signed-up organisations. WHAT IT DOES: one new function, identity.organization_staff_kinds(target_organization_id uuid, OUT organization_kinds text[], OUT organization_products text[]), one row, LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER, search_path pg_catalog, identity, pg_temp, owned by the owner of identity.organization_self_service_state. organization_kinds: the distinct effective kinds, sorted, of every approved application of the organisation (status 'approved' with that organization_id: each governed approval, also one that reused the organisation, whose product row already existed or was later suspended, and the self sign-up while pending or reviewed; a released self sign-up is 'rejected' by 0086's organization_applications_self_service_release_ck); 'other' gives the kind its product makes it, exactly as identity.staff_invitable_roles and identity-api's staffInvitableRoles read it (ehr or migrate hospital, laboratory laboratory, pharmacy pharmacy); an organisation promoted from the legacy system (identity.organizations.source_system 'legacy_identity', scripts/promote-legacy-identity.mjs) also gives hospital, so the hospital status Q91 A gave it stays when a governed approval later reuses it for a laboratory or pharmacy product. organization_products: the distinct product codes, sorted, of the organisation's active organization_products rows. Both only of the listed values and empty when nothing is recorded (the sealed QA Hospital, Demo Hospital and Demo Outreach, outreach groups). EXECUTE revoked from PUBLIC and granted to hid_identity_runtime only, in the migration (when the role exists) and in runtime-grants.sql. PRECONDITIONS (catalog reads only, 55000, nothing applied): 0123 applied (identity.sealed_qa_facility(uuid) exists) else '0124: 0001-0123 must be applied first'; not applied yet else '0124: already applied'; the nine columns it reads with 0002's, 0046's and 0086's types; the organization_type, application product_code, application status, product product_code and product status checks exactly 0046's; 0086's self-service release check by md5 of its definition (7d5cf043ccf443e618172df8462fb014); the bodies it mirrors or takes its owner from by md5 (organization_self_service_state c67aa5224b2aa3d95e4415e26787d470, staff_invitable_roles b6f4068712d97284fd95d169e3bde0cf). Post-checks: attributes (record of uuid in, two text[] out, names), owner, and no EXECUTE for any role but hid_identity_runtime. No table, column, index, constraint, policy, trigger, role or permission change; no other function changes; no row read or written by the file; CREATE FUNCTION and GRANT take no table lock. runtime-grants.sql gains one block (grant EXECUTE to hid_identity_runtime; revoke from PUBLIC) after 0123's; the production file was a248edf52f9191280ae5e03135d2da658c095b7d0eecb818d243b4e13e09fac9. BACKWARD COMPATIBLE: today's identity-api never calls the function and works unchanged with 0124 applied, so the release order is migration first, then the identity-api of this branch, whose staff context (STAFF_CONTEXT_SQL) adds one lateral call per membership and whose session adds facility.organizationKinds only when a kind is recorded and facility.organizationProducts only beside it (no change to the session of a membership with no kind). An identity-api image rollback is safe with 0124 left in place. ROLLBACK of the schema: a forward migration may drop the function only after no running identity-api calls it. REVIEW FIXES of 17 November 2026 (before signature): 'other' with laboratory or pharmacy now gives that kind (it gave none, so such an organisation counted as a hospital); kinds come from every approved application, so a suspended product or an approved application with no product row keeps its kind (suspending a laboratory's only product no longer widens its administrator to every site); the active products are returned so a laboratory or pharmacy that holds ehr or migrate keeps that site; a legacy-promoted organisation keeps hospital after a governed reuse. PROVED 2026-11-17 on throwaway PostgreSQL 16 clusters run as pgrun (fictional data only, stopped and deleted afterwards), after the review fixes: FRESH install of all 125 files: apply, 0 pending, role bootstrap and verification; UPGRADE from 0001-0123 with production's runtime-grants.sql: plan exactly [0124] at the sha256 below, dry run rolled back (no function), applied, 0 pending, this branch's runtime-grants.sql applied and verified; the file again answers '0124: already applied', and without 0123 '0124: 0001-0123 must be applied first'. Database suites (96: 16 in database/tests, 80 in test/database, including test/database/organization-staff-kinds.integration.sql): 96 pass on the fresh and on the upgraded database. The suite checks the function's attributes, owner and ACL (Identity runtimes only, not PUBLIC, the schema test runtime or any other runtime; no runtime privilege on the two tables), twenty-five fictional organisations (no application, each kind, a suspended product, an approved application with no product row, two and three applications, other with each product, a laboratory with migrate, a pharmacy with ehr, pending, reviewed and released self sign-ups including a pharmacy that signed up for migrate and an other that signed up for laboratory, a self sign-up whose product is suspended, a legacy-promoted organisation alone and reused for a laboratory product) for both kinds and products, null and unknown ids, the same answers as hid_identity_runtime, and, with the sealed tenants installed as their suites do, QA Hospital {} {}, QA Laboratory {laboratory} {laboratory}, QA Pharmacy {pharmacy} {pharmacy}, Demo Hospital {} {}, Demo Laboratory {laboratory} {laboratory}, Demo Pharmacy {pharmacy} {pharmacy}, Demo Outreach {} {}, and admin@'s three memberships read by one lateral call each; five mutants of the body (other with laboratory dropped, other with pharmacy dropped, the approved-status filter dropped, the legacy hospital dropped, suspended products counted as held) each fail it. identity-api's STAFF_CONTEXT_SQL, run as hid_identity_api_runtime on that database with the QA tenant installed, answers admin@'s memberships QA Hospital [] [], QA Laboratory [laboratory] [laboratory], QA Pharmacy [pharmacy] [pharmacy]. identity-api: tsc --noEmit passes; full jest 105 suites, 2688 tests pass (product-gate.spec.ts pins admin@ on each site, lab-only, pharmacy-only and lab-and-pharmacy org_admin and admin, no-kind, hospital, clinic and legacy-reused organisations, other with each product, a laboratory or pharmacy holding ehr or migrate, a laboratory whose only product is suspended, review-pending administrators of a laboratory, a pharmacy, a pharmacy that signed up on migrate., a laboratory that signed up on ehr., an other on lab., a hospital and a clinic, the refresh of the migrate. pharmacy administrator, and unchanged clinical, lab and pharmacy roles). npm --prefix release test 98 of 98 and scripts/verify-migration-ledger.mjs (125 migrations) pass. services/ehr-api scripts/test-staging-schema-upgrade.mjs on a throwaway local PostgreSQL 16 (NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS migrator): baseline 124 files with the runtime-grants.sql of ca44aadf^ (production's), declared [0124_organization_staff_kinds.sql], dry run rolled back, applied, migration grants equal runtime-grants.sql (2626 privileges compared), clean install, row security unchanged (206), no-FORCE baseline: passed. The full TUF staging migration rehearsal (scripts/tuf-staging-migration-rehearsal.mjs, run as the non-root pgrun user on PostgreSQL 16.15) passed, its runtime verifiers included; the provider-enrollment verifier's staff-context check now expects the kinds and products columns (empty for its organisations with no application or product).
